source.commitRole: implementation baseline plus real-model integration in this branch

converterContract.deadline: Immutable BFF operation expiry; maximum one hour, missing/expired handle revokes ready

authentication: existing installation headers on every request; private no-store
transport: polling (1000ms suggested); no SSE in v1

protocol.syntax: comma-separated token list; exact case-sensitive tokens; surrounding whitespace and empty items ignored; unknown tokens ignored
protocol.required: pose-body-only-v1 (missing: 426 INTERACTIVE_PROTOCOL_REQUIRED on every interactive route)

routes.DELETE /{operationId}: 200 cancelled (idempotent); abort queued and active worker
routes.GET /{operationId}/model: 200 server state; Content-Type selects the decoder: application/vnd.standin.solved-pose-state-v1+json (typed-JSON packet, modelResponse) or application/vnd.standin.solved-pose-state-v2 (binary bytes, modelResponseBinary; only for requests advertising solved-state-binary-v2, otherwise 426 INTERACTIVE_PROTOCOL_REQUIRED); never client matrices
routes.GET /{operationId}/file: 200 verified FBX only; latest revision + full release/current-state recheck
routes.GET /{operationId}/poster: 200 server-authoritative static PNG or 404; never blocks list/export
routes.GET /?candidateId={candidateId}: 200 {schemaVersion,currentRevision,currentStateHash,appearanceExport:{version:fbx-outline-v1,available:boolean},skinExport:{version:fbx-skin-v1,available:boolean,supportedIds:string[]},operation|null}; optional URL-encoded appearance/skin JSON matches exact head; current candidate ownership required

POST /{operationId}/client-frame.request: ClientFrame JSON schema below; max 1 MiB PNG / 1.5 MB HTTP body
POST /{operationId}/client-frame.response: 201 auxiliary UI-only acknowledgement; same-hash retry idempotent; never accuracy/file safety evidence; never authoritative history poster

routes.GET /v1/analysis/jobs/{jobId}/people/{pe: 200 archived current-selection server PNG; separate from operation/file expiry, same owned-job retention/source checks
routes.GET /{operationId}/variants: 200 bounded exact previously verified owner-bound hand variants; current ready operation required; binary-state operations always 409 CONVERTER_INTEGRITY (no v1 hand atlas), without a Converter call
routes.GET /{operationId}/skin-assets/{sha256}: 200 bounded approved application/gzip UV or image/png preview after installation/current operation/selection/asset revalidation; private/no-store, exact SHA/bytes; no arbitrary hashes/URLs

Operation.stateHash: null while solving; Converter canonical snapshot SHA256 assigned once after solve
Operation.exportState: not-requested | queued | building | ready | failed | superseded | cancelled
Operation.selectionHash: sha256 canonical server selection identity (immutable from prepare)
Operation.exportReceipt: null before ready; {schema,operationId,revision,stateHash,artifactSha256,artifactBytes,runtimeRevision,packetModelSha256,solverVersion,validationVersion,initialFbxRequired:true,nativeSaved:false} after validated receipt
Operation.appearance: optional nonzero versioned appearance; zero omitted

rules: Persist body/hand/scope/refine and confirmed candidate using existing routes before prepare; request never mutates these selections
revision strictly increases per installation/job/person; expectedRevision+expectedStateHash compare-and-swap; retries reuse mutationId and identical body
Every response must match current client revision+stateHash before display; never save previous ready file after hand/refine change
stateHash includes installation/job/person/candidate, source/refined hashes, character/rig/shape, hands, scope, server camera, runtime/solver identities; excludes orbit, names, timestamps, paths
preview-ready is not release authority; no native-save/export-completed event during preparation
Private server poster uses same stateHash/revision; stale render cannot overwrite current frame; client capture is auxiliary UI only
Legacy framed ready/preview, semantic static lists, scene and explicit download contracts retained; rollout disabled by default

selectionHash is the stable pre-solve request fingerprint; stateHash is the Converter full canonical snapshot hash. Revision fences even pre-solve replies. expectedStateHash nullable, compared when non-null.
Archived static representative frames are separate from expiring export authority; every image delivery still verifies current ownership/selection/source. Existing thumbnailUrl is retained.
Client frame cameraHash is a claimed auxiliary metadata value, never trusted camera/projection evidence. One auxiliary image per operation; cannot populate authoritative history.

Clients must branch on the /model Content-Type, not on what they advertised: an operation negotiated as binary can still be served as v1 when the Converter answers v1 or the operator switch is off. X-Standin-State-Hash always equals SHA256 of the delivered binary bytes (v2) or the packet stateHash (v1).
changes: Initial BFF polling draft; converter packet schema pending
Aligned snapshot hash semantics to Converter solved_state.py: no synthetic geometry hash before solve; separate selectionHash.

Implemented durable polling/head recovery/cancel/queue, strict canonical packet+receipt+file checks, server history archive and auxiliary frame upload; actual Converter HTTP transport and full camera mapping remain blocked.
Pinned BFF implementation 7dcfcfd and Converter draft implementation 3fa41e71; confirmed no HTTP transport and no frozen/activated integration.

Real-model v2 integration: authenticated internal HTTP, normalized search projection, strict file-canonical display/export correspondence, prebuilt 5/5 local Top5 and bounded verified hand tables. Default flags remain off.
Strict appearance-bound final export boundary; rejected CSP hull remains unavailable, zero legacy unchanged.
Align native-v2/culling/surface/continuous full-width/width2 cropped target proof with current posed-FBX scope; preserve v1 rejection and zero path.

2026-11-12 binary solved state: optional X-Standin-Interactive-Protocol token solved-state-binary-v2, per-operation requestedStateEncoding/stateEncoding, application/vnd.standin.solved-pose-state-v2 /model bytes validated with the vendored Converter reader, INTERACTIVE_BINARY_STATE operator switch; v1 behaviour unchanged.
implementationStatus: implemented private Converter HTTP/camera/static/verified-hand transport; local real-asset and full-wire tests pass; disabled by default

modelResponse.stateHash: SHA256 of original canonicalState ASCII bytes
modelResponse.exportState: not-requested (packet creation readiness, consult operation for current export state)
modelResponse.canonicalState: Converter canonical JSON payload: schema, identity, bounded model (bones+skin+mesh+split normals), safety, dependencies; float values encoded {$f64: 16 hex chars}. See Converter contract; no external assets or client matrices.

modelResponseBinary.body: Converter binary state bytes, delivered unchanged (layout: Standin-server docs/INTERACTIVE_STATE_BINARY_V2.md; reader: Standin-server converter/shared/interactive_pose_v2.mjs readSolvedStateV2)
modelResponseBinary.stateHash: SHA256 of all body bytes (= X-Standin-State-Hash = operation stateHash)
modelResponseBinary.modelSha256: SHA256 of the bytes from the STNDMDL2 magic to the end (= export receipt packetModelSha256)
modelResponseBinary.logicalContent: lossless re-encoding of the v1 canonicalState payload (schema, identity, model, safety, dependencies)

stateEncodingNegotiation.decidedAt: prepare (POST /); stored per operation as requestedStateEncoding (absent = v1)
stateEncodingNegotiation.binaryWhen: request advertises solved-state-binary-v2 AND INTERACTIVE_BINARY_STATE is on (default); the switch is re-checked when the preview is solved
stateEncodingNegotiation.converterRequest: POST /interactive/v1/solve with X-Standin-State-Encoding: standin-binary-f64le-v2 (header omitted for v1, request otherwise unchanged)
stateEncodingNegotiation.fallback: Converter v1 answer (older Converter or CONVERTER_INTERACTIVE_BINARY_STATE=0) is validated by the unchanged v1 path and the operation is recorded as v1
stateEncodingNegotiation.fixedWith: published encoding stored as stateEncoding in the same update as stateHash and never changed; absent = typed-f64be-json-v1 (older rows or a state published by an older BFF replica)
stateEncodingNegotiation.capability: analysis job result capabilities.solvedStateBinary = {protocolToken: "solved-state-binary-v2", mediaType, available: operator switch}, present only when interactiveState.available; a separate key because clients parse interactiveState strictly. Clients may add the token only after seeing it, which keeps a BFF rollback from turning the token list into 426 responses.

activation.binaryStateSwitch: INTERACTIVE_BINARY_STATE=1 default; 0 = v1 for new and still-solving operations; any value other than 0/1/true/false fails startup

staticAssets.resolve: batched offline Converter manifest; never Blender per card
staticAssets.capability: interactive-preview-capability-v1 only when all returned candidates have prebuilt source/character/scope coverage

appearanceExport.status: scoped native v2 posed-FBX-import support; legacy opaque v1 rejected; default off
appearanceExport.zero: omit before identity hash; preserve existing bytes
appearanceExport.selectionIdentity: nonzero appearance + complete current server selection; base Converter packet schema unchanged
appearanceExport.receipt: separate final outlined-fbx-receipt-v1 proof, base receipt retained; no ready URL without both

support.check: live supported_targets exact row + requested width + independently pinned BFF matrix; summary lists/booleans insufficient

skinExport.status: scoped full skin-only and combined-width2 support, independently pinned; default off
skinExport.default: omit before request and selection hashing; identical legacy file path when outline also zero/omitted
skinExport.selectionIdentity: base server selection + optional nonzero appearance + nondefault skin + digest of exact approved asset version/manifest/model/UV/texture/runtime/target
skinExport.pipeline: canonical base FBX -> skin -> optional native-v2 outline
skinExport.proof: separate base receipt + normalized skinProof + optional outline; base.final=skin.source and skin.final=outline.source
skinExport.support: exact current #168 male/female full, four nondefault IDs, outline0/omission or exact2; partial UV lineage, personal/previous models, scene/VRM unsupported
skinExport.preview: optional authoritative Operation.skinPreview, exact neutral topology/UV and prebuilt2048 PNG; owned operation skin-assets/{sha256} paths, final4096 texture SHA separate
